name: whale-desktop
author: xTanTHaix
description: Isolated Docker Linux desktop on Windows (Xvfb + XFCE4 + pywebview) with TurboJPEG 4:4:4 + lossless PNG live viewer, AT-SPI2 + Thai/English OCR Set-of-Mark UI inspection, smooth cursor & key-hold control, macro batches, and offline image backup.
suggestedPrompts: Start Whale Desktop, inspect visible UI controls, and open Terminal
Take a screenshot of Whale Desktop and read what is shown on screen
Save the running Whale Desktop container state into the plugin image backup
